item.title: DeepSeek releases open-weights math model with IMO gold medal performance
item.description:
By scaling reasoning with reinforcement learning that rewards correct final answers, LLMs have improved from poor performance to saturating quantitative reasoning competitions like AIME and HMMT in one year. Moreover, many mathematical tasks like theorem proving require rigorous step-by-step derivation rather than numerical answers, making final answer rewards inapplicable. While much work remains, these results suggest that self-verifiable mathematical reasoning is a feasible research direction that may help develop more capable mathematical AI systems.

item.title: Show HN: CurioQuest – A simple web trivia/fun facts game
item.description:
Play exciting games that will challenge your mind and make you laugh out loud. Learn as you play: uncover amazing fun facts, meet amazing characters, and explore stories full of surprises. Invite your friends and party together.

HN Discussion

Read Original Article

Top 4 Comments:

Timwi:

I would prefer a mode without a timer. Especially on the explanation page after a question.

There are a couple questions I encountered with wrong answers. One question asked me to solve x/4=3 and then insisted that the answer was 24, which is wrong. Another asked: “if you have 3 apples and you take 2 away, how many do you have?” It insisted that the answer was 2, but since the question clearly states that I have three apples, I insist that the answer is 3.

Otherwise, great website! I like how well it works on mobile, good job.

daliz:
